items.title: How “American Gothic” Took On a Life of Its Own
items.summary: After decades of collecting pop culture riffs on the iconic 1930 painting, Wanda M. Corn traces the work’s canonization and the life of its maker Grant Wood, whose story remains largely overlooked.
